items.headline:
WARSH SPEECH PUTS SEPTEMBER HIKE BACK IN PLAY

Markets sharply repriced the September Fed decision following Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech.

The probability of the Fed holding rates dropped from 71% before the speech to 50%, while odds of a 25bp hike jumped from 30% to 49%.
